phase: shared work2 lab as created (no phase change)

steps.action: Unauthorized administration: a Legal Team Member opens Settings General and Settings Users
steps.expected: Lands on Profile; the users and invite APIs refuse
steps.actual: Settings General and Settings Users both sent Nadia to /settings/profile (first heading "Personal"). GET /api/v1/users answered 403; POST /api/v1/auth/invites answered 403.

steps.action: Unauthorized administration: a Business User opens Settings
steps.expected: Sent to the Portal
steps.actual: doc030-org-bu0-mugtybq7@helix.example entered through a Portal sign-in link on an allowed domain (["helix.example"]) and is a Business User. Opening /settings, /settings/general, /settings/users landed on {"/settings":"/portal/onboarding","/settings/general":"/portal/onboarding","/settings/users":"/portal/onboarding"}. GET /api/v1/users answered 403.

steps.action: Update organization details step 2: Organization name saves on Enter, Escape restores before saving, reload keeps the saved value
steps.expected: Saved status; Escape restores the previous name; value survives reload
steps.actual: Enter showed Saved and "DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Helix mugtybq7" survived reload. Escape on an unsaved draft put "DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Helix mugtybq7" back in the field, and after reload the saved name was still "DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Helix mugtybq7".

steps.action: Update organization details step 3: Upload beside Logo; wrong type or over 5 MB shows the 5 MB message; unreadable or over 16 million pixels shows the readability message; a supported file saves
steps.expected: Four refusals with the quoted messages and no change; a PNG and an SVG save
steps.actual: Refusals: {"text file":"5 MB message","PNG over 5 MB":"5 MB message","unreadable .png":"readability message","4001 x 4001 PNG (16,008,001 pixels)":"readability message"}; the saved logo stayed unchanged after them. The 5 MB message read "That logo must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG image 5 MB or smaller. Pick another file.". The readability message read "The logo must be a readable PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG with no more than 16 million pixels.". A 64 x 64 PNG then showed Saved, and an SVG showed Saved and was displayed beside Logo after reload. The General pane had 0 remove, delete or clear buttons.

steps.action: The saved Organization name and logo appear on the staff and Business Portal sign-in pages without an account, and in the staff app and Portal headers after sign-in
steps.expected: Both sign-in pages show the name and an Organization logo image; both headers show them
steps.actual: In a browser with no session, /auth/login began "DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Helix mugtybq7 Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Sign in Email Password Sign i" with 1 image named Organization logo; /portal/login began "DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Helix mugtybq7 Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Business Portal sign-in Email" with 1. Signed in, the staff app header read "openlaw / DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Helix mugtybq7 / Help 9+ DO" with 1 SVG logo image, and the Business User's Portal header read "openlaw / DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Helix mugtybq7 Legal portal Sign out" with 1.

steps.action: Invite a colleague steps 1 to 3: Invite user, Display name, Email, Role Legal team member, Send invite
steps.expected: Role offers Legal team member and Administrator; new Invited row; a Set password email that expires in 1 hour, with the organization name and logo in its header
steps.actual: Role radios were ["Legal team member","Administrator"]. After Send invite the row read Invited with actions ["Resend invite","Revoke invite"] and no role control. Mailpit received "Set your OpenLaw password" with a Set password button and the line "The link expires in 1 hour". Its header named "DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Helix mugtybq7" and showed the inline image org-logo@openlaw (the uploaded logo, not the OpenLaw mark).

steps.action: Restore the organization name and logo; sign-in pages and email follow
steps.expected: Original name saved by leaving the field; original logo restored
steps.actual: Typing "Helix Software Group" and leaving the field showed Saved and survived reload. The original logo (none) was restored through PATCH /api/v1/org/general (200) because the pane has no remove control. /auth/login then showed "Helix Software Group Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Sign in Email Password Sign" with 0 logo images. The shared organization identity was changed for about a minute.

steps.action: Update organization details steps 4 and 5: Default timezone saves; reload; Default locale offers English (United States) only
steps.expected: Timezone saved and restored; one locale option
steps.actual: Default timezone saved America/Toronto and kept it after reload. Default locale offered only ["English (United States)"]. The timezone was restored to Europe/London.

steps.action: OpenLaw rejects an invalid address
steps.expected: No row is created
steps.actual: The dialog stayed open with the browser message "Please include an '@' in the email address. 'doc030-org-invalid-address' is missing an '@'." and no row was added (72 users before and after). The invite route refused a malformed address with 400.

steps.action: Inviting an already pending address with the same role resends its invitation
steps.expected: A new email; still one row
steps.actual: The dialog closed, a new "Set your OpenLaw password" email arrived, and the table still had exactly 1 row for the address.

steps.action: An invitation that names a different role for a pending address is refused
steps.expected: "This user already exists with a different role."; no email
steps.actual: The dialog showed "This user already exists with a different role." and Mailpit received 0 messages.

steps.action: An invitation for an account that has already signed in is refused; a Business User's address gets the same refusal
steps.expected: "This user has already activated their account." for Nadia and for Jonas
steps.actual: Invite user answered {"nadia.haddad@helix.example":"This user has already activated their account.","jonas.weber@helix.example":"This user has already activated their account."}.

steps.action: Resend invite on the pending row sends a replacement link
steps.expected: Row shows Saved; a new Set password email
steps.actual: The row showed "Saved" and a new "Set your OpenLaw password" email arrived.

steps.action: Invite step 4: the first sign-in by a sign-in link (Legal User Authentication has Email magic link on) changes the row to Active
steps.expected: Colleague signs in from the staff sign-in page; row Active with a role control
steps.actual: Legal User Authentication was {"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}. The staff page said "Helix Software Group Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Check your email If doc030-org-a-mugtybq7@helix.example is eligible, a sign-in link is ". Opening "Sign in to OpenLaw" signed the colleague in (landed on /; role legal_team_member). Daniel's Users table then showed the row as Active with a role control and actions ["Legal team member","Archive"].

steps.action: Invite step 4: a colleague sets a password from the Set password email link; the row becomes Active
steps.expected: Password set; password sign-in works; row Active
steps.actual: "Set your OpenLaw password" arrived; "Password set" appeared; the colleague signed in with the new password (me 200). The row read Active with a role control.

steps.action: The activated Legal Team Member checks their access
steps.expected: No administration: Users sends them to Profile
steps.actual: Settings Users sent the colleague to /settings/profile; no Invite user control was offered.

steps.action: Revoke invite withdraws an unused invitation and removes the row
steps.expected: The pending row is removed
steps.actual: The Invited row for DOC-030 admin-org V-C36 Bryn mugtybq7 disappeared after Revoke invite, and GET /api/v1/users no longer listed the address.

steps.action: Change a role: the role control on an Active row offers three roles; Administrator applies on the colleague's next action without signing in again
steps.expected: Administrator, Legal team member, Business user; colleague reaches Settings Users on next navigation
steps.actual: The role menu offered ["Administrator","Legal team member","Business user"]. Choosing Administrator showed "Saved" and the reloaded row read Administrator. The colleague's existing session opened Settings Users on its next navigation without signing in again.

steps.action: Change the role back to Legal team member
steps.expected: The colleague loses administration on the next request
steps.actual: The row showed "Saved" for Legal team member. The colleague's same session got 403 from GET /api/v1/users on its next request.

steps.action: Promote a Portal-created Business User to Legal team member: the row stays Active with its role control; return it to Business user
steps.expected: Active Business user row; after promotion still Active with role control; access follows the role
steps.actual: A Portal sign-in link created an Active Business user row with a role control. Choosing Legal team member showed "Saved"; the row stayed Active with its role control and read Legal team member, and the person's own session reported role legal_team_member on its next request. Choosing Business user showed "Saved" and the row returned to Active Business user. The Invited branch did not occur, as the article says for a Business User who has signed in.

steps.action: Your own row has no Archive action and no … button; Administrators cannot archive themselves
steps.expected: No row actions on Daniel's row; "You cannot archive yourself."
steps.actual: Daniel's own row had a role control, no Archive and no "More actions for daniel.okafor@helix.example" button (buttons: ["Administrator"]). A direct archive request for his own account was refused with 409: "You cannot archive yourself.".

steps.action: Sign out user from the row's … button (More actions for the email address); sessions stop; the account stays active and can sign in again
steps.expected: Menu offers Sign out user; colleague's next request needs sign-in; row Active; password sign-in works
steps.actual: The "More actions for doc030-org-c-mugtybq7@helix.example" menu offered ["Sign out user"]; choosing it showed "Saved". The colleague's session went from 200 to 401 on /api/v1/me and the app sent it to /auth/login. The row stayed Active, and a password sign-in worked again (200).

steps.action: Reassign work before archiving: fixture Contract with the colleague as Legal Owner
steps.expected: Contract created (API fixture); checked after archive
steps.actual: Created Contract 252 with the colleague as Legal Owner through the API (fixture setup; the check follows the archive).

steps.action: Archive and restore steps 1 and 2: Archive on the row; it leaves the ordinary list; sessions end; new sign-in blocked; nothing is reassigned
steps.expected: Row hidden; live session ends; password sign-in refused; no sign-in link; Legal Owner unchanged
steps.actual: Check failed: locator.waitFor: Timeout 15000ms exceeded. Call log: [2m  - waiting for getByRole('heading', { name: 'Check your email' }) to be visible[22m

steps.action: Archive and restore steps 3 and 4: Show archived, Restore, and ask the user to sign in again
steps.expected: Restored row Active; the revoked session stays revoked; a new sign-in works
steps.actual: With Show archived on, the row read Archived with a Restore action. Restore showed "Saved" and the row read Active. The old browser session still got 401; a fresh password sign-in got 200.
